hints.title: Sort Intervals by Start Time
hints.text: Sorting both participants availability intervals chronologically enables synchronized timeline scanning.

hints.title: Calculate Overlap Length
hints.text: For the current interval pair, overlap starts at maximum start and ends at minimum end.

hints.title: Advance Earlier Ending Interval
hints.text: If the overlap spans at least duration, return start to start plus duration; otherwise advance the interval ending sooner.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.time: O(N log N + M log M)
variables: N: number of slots in slots1
M: number of slots in slots2
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs takes O(N * M) time without utilizing timeline ordering.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting both interval lists enables linear simultaneous scanning with constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should accurately advance whichever interval ends earlier to seek overlapping opportunities.
complexity.notes: Returns empty array if no common slot satisfies duration.
